name: Mentat

startingGear.rule: Take every fixed item, then one item from each line.

description: A trained human computer. You ingest data, weigh probabilities and deliver conclusions your House stakes its future on.
agendaHints: Prove a projection your master dismissed
Find who is feeding you false data
Keep a secret calculation to yourself
signatureItemHints: A ledger no one else can read
notes: Key drive TRUTH; key skills UNDERSTAND and DISCIPLINE.

name: Bene Gesserit

startingGear.rule: Take every fixed item, then one item from each line.

description: A Sister of an ancient order of body and mind control. You serve the House, but the order’s plans come first.
agendaHints: Report a bloodline secret to the order
Protect a child the order has an interest in
Test someone without them knowing
signatureItemHints: A child’s toy from a forgotten mission
notes: Key drive FAITH; key skills DISCIPLINE and COMMUNICATE.

name: Swordmaster

startingGear.rule: Take every fixed item, then one item from each line.

description: A blade-master of the Ginaz tradition. You train the House’s fighters and stand between its heir and every knife.
agendaHints: Train an heir who refuses to listen
Settle an old dueling debt
Find the gap in the household guard
signatureItemHints: A blade from your own master
A dueling scar you chose to keep
notes: Key drive DUTY; key skills BATTLE and MOVE.

name: Noble Scion

startingGear.rule: Take every fixed item, then one item from each line.

description: Blood of the House. Your name opens doors and your mistakes become everyone’s problem.
agendaHints: Win the respect of a skeptical vassal
Secure an alliance by marriage or bargain
Hide a weakness from your rivals
signatureItemHints: A letter you have never opened
notes: Key drive POWER; key skills COMMUNICATE and UNDERSTAND.

name: Fremen Guide

startingGear.rule: Take every fixed item, then one item from each line.

description: A child of the deep desert who has chosen, for now, to walk with outsiders. Your sietch is watching how they treat you.
agendaHints: Return a debt of water to your sietch
Judge whether these outsiders can be trusted
Keep the location of your sietch secret
notes: Key drive FAITH; key skills MOVE and BATTLE.

name: Suk Doctor

startingGear.rule: Take every fixed item, then one item from each line.

description: A physician bearing the diamond tattoo of Imperial Conditioning. Everyone trusts you with their life — that is your burden.
appearanceHints: hair bound in a silver ring
agendaHints: Save a patient your House would rather lose
Learn who is testing your conditioning
Keep a medical secret
notes: Key drive DUTY; key skills UNDERSTAND and DISCIPLINE.

name: Spy/Agent

startingGear.rule: Take every fixed item, then one item from each line.

description: Eyes and ears of the House. You go where the nobles cannot be seen to go and return with what they need to know.
agendaHints: Unmask a double agent
Protect an informant at any cost
Plant false information on a rival
signatureItemHints: A coin with a hidden message
notes: Key drive TRUTH; key skills MOVE and COMMUNICATE.

name: Smuggler

startingGear.rule: Take every fixed item, then one item from each line.

description: You move spice, water and people past the Guild’s tariffs and the Houses’ patrols. Everyone needs you; no one admits it.
agendaHints: Pay off a debt to a dangerous patron
Find a buyer for an illegal cargo
Keep your crew alive
signatureItemHints: A debt marker you will never cash
notes: Key drive POWER; key skills MOVE and COMMUNICATE.

name: Planetologist

startingGear.rule: Take every fixed item, then one item from each line.

description: An Imperial ecologist sent to study Arrakis. The more you learn about the desert, the less you trust the Empire.
agendaHints: Prove a theory about the spice cycle
Protect a hidden water project
Decide which side you are on
notes: Key drive JUSTICE; key skills UNDERSTAND and MOVE.

name: Guild Envoy

startingGear.rule: Take every fixed item, then one item from each line.

description: A representative of the Spacing Guild seconded to the House. You speak softly because the whole Imperium depends on your masters.
agendaHints: Secure the spice flow for the Guild
Watch for prescient interference
Learn what the House hides from the Guild
notes: Key drive POWER; key skills COMMUNICATE and UNDERSTAND.
